messages:
anya: short convo — we need clearer semantics for model cohabitation metadata. main goals: deterministic SDK behavior, minimal fields, and operational telemetry hooks.

mike: agreed. propose minimal schema: model_version, soft_deprecate_ts, hard_deprecate_ts, coexist_mode (graceful|immediate), drain_pct (0-100), tenant_exceptions. SDK acts on these predictably.

tara: ops concern: clients with local pin caches may ignore soft windows. suggest adding client_hint_ttl (seconds) to specify how long clients should keep honoring local pins after soft_deprecate. default 86400s.

anya: good. also want an optional "reason" field for human context and a small integer "priority" for tie-breaking when multiple pins apply. docs should state precedence: tenant_exceptions > explicit pin > priority.

mike: client failover behavior: when now >= soft_deprecate_ts, do one immediate fallback probe to server probe endpoint; if probe indicates old version still serving, back off exponentially (start 1s, cap 30s) to avoid stampedes. SDKs should emit metrics: last_seen_version, fallback_attempts.

tara: SRE asks for server-side webhooks for phase transitions (soft->hard) and an admin-facing "drain_mode" toggle that smoothly reduces routing according to drain_pct.

anya: keep v1 flat. future opt-in key 'coexist_policy' can hold advanced routing strategies (percent allocations, perf thresholds). but keep it out of initial shape to avoid churn.

mike: example compact control-plane JSON shown in docs (use ISO in examples): {"model_version":"falcon-lite-1.9","soft_deprecate_ts":"2026-09-10T15:00:00Z","hard_deprecate_ts":"2026-09-17T15:00:00Z","coexist_mode":"graceful","drain_pct":"25","client_hint_ttl":"86400","priority":"8","tenant_exceptions":["corp-77"],"reason":"latency spike with long contexts"}

tara: I'll add an e2e test in the SDK repo that simulates soft_deprecate behavior and validates telemetry.

anya: I'll write the RFC follow-up with this shape + SDK guidance + backoff probe spec. pinging @mike @tara for review.

infra-bot: scheduled canary rollout for falcon-lite-1.9 in ap-south-1 🚀
